full_prompt_en: A square atmospheric landscape painting shows a wooden farmhouse on a snowy rise beneath heavy storm clouds. The house stands on the right, with a steep dark roof, weathered plank siding, and two warm glowing windows. A small attached section extends leftward, its porch or entry catching a line of amber light. A narrow snow-covered path curves from the lower center toward the house, climbing between dark grasses and uneven banks. Bare trees with thin black branches rise around the building and along the left side. Low rough fences cross the lower right and middle ground. In the distance on the left, a small blue-gray settlement and low hills recede under a pale opening in the clouds. The sky occupies the upper third, layered with charcoal, slate blue, and dim cream; a broken bright gap near the horizon draws the eye past the house. Snow is painted in cool gray-white with warm reflected streaks near the lights, not a uniform pure white. Brown reeds, rocks, and exposed earth puncture the snow along the path. Thick and thin brushwork mingle: broad soft masses model the clouds, short rough strokes describe the grass and weathered timber, and a few sharp marks pick out the fence. Light comes from both the cloudy horizon and the glowing windows, creating long mild highlights on the path while trees and eaves stay dark. There are no visible people or readable signs. The overall composition balances the dark upright house against an open wintry valley, with warm domestic light held inside a broad cold storm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形大气风景画描绘一座木农舍立在积雪坡地上，头顶压着厚重暴风云。房屋位于右侧，有陡峭深色屋顶、陈旧木板墙和两扇暖光窗。一个较小附属部分向左延伸，门廊或入口承接一线琥珀光。狭窄雪路从下方中央弯向房屋，在深草和起伏雪岸之间上坡。光秃树木的细黑枝条在房屋周围和左侧升起。低矮粗糙围栏横过右下和中景。左侧远处，小片蓝灰聚落和低丘退入云层下的浅亮裂口。天空占上方三分之一，炭色、石板蓝和暗奶油色层叠；地平线附近断开的亮隙将视线引过房屋。雪以冷灰白绘成，靠近灯光有暖反射条纹，不是均匀纯白。棕色芦草、石块与裸土点破小路两侧积雪。厚薄笔触混合：宽而柔的体量塑出云，短粗笔描出草和旧木，少数锐利笔痕勾出围栏。光同时来自多云地平线和发亮窗户，在道路上形成长而温和的亮部，树木与屋檐则保持深暗。没有可见人物或可读招牌。整体构图以深色直立房屋平衡开阔冬谷，将温暖室内光包在宽广寒冷的风暴之中。
style_prompt_en: An atmospheric landscape painting combines broad softly blended dark masses with short rough strokes and a few sharp linear accents. Charcoal, slate blue, cold gray-white, weathered brown, and compact amber light define the palette. A warm focal cluster glows within a wide cool field, with reflected streaks extending through the lower plane. Bare branching lines and low horizontal divisions organize the middle distance, while a pale horizon opening provides depth beneath a heavy upper band. Edges soften in the distant haze and become more tactile in near textured patches. Lighting comes from both diffuse low sky and isolated warm sources, keeping the mood stormy yet inhabited. The finish is rugged, luminous, and quietly dramatic.
style_prompt_zh: 大气风景画将宽阔柔和融合的深色体量与短粗笔触、少数锐利线性重点结合。炭色、石板蓝、冷灰白、陈旧棕色与紧凑琥珀光确定色域。一簇暖色焦点在宽大冷色域中发亮，反射线条延伸穿过下方平面。光秃分枝线和低水平分界组织中景，厚重上方色带下的浅亮远界提供纵深。边缘在远雾中柔化，在近处纹理斑块中更有触感。光既来自漫射的低处天空，也来自孤立暖光源，让氛围暴风般阴沉却有人居暖意。成品粗粝、发光且安静地富戏剧性。
theme_en: A lamplit farmhouse beside a snowy path under storm clouds
theme_zh: 暴风云下雪路旁亮灯的农舍
name: Terry Redlin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
